pivot.description: feet contact point; keep identical in every frame

visualLock: Keep the same young dark-haired male researcher in every frame.
Preserve the dark long coat/cloak with blue and gold accents, straps, bags, and scientific equipment from the reference.
Keep silhouette, face, hair, outfit, and equipment consistent between frames.
Use the supplied reference as the source of truth; do not redesign the character.
No background, UI, text, shadows baked into the background, or environment pixels.

walk.purpose: grounded walking cycle; feet must not slide

attack.purpose: physical attack; clear wind-up, strike, recovery

echoCast.purpose: search pulse that reveals traces; not an attack

hit.purpose: brief damage reaction, then return to locomotion

menuEnter.purpose: entering menus with a brief cyan glyph flourish

delivery.format: PNG atlas plus JSON metadata, with individual SVG source frames

sourceAssets.origin: Procedurally generated SVG paths and shapes; no extracted reference sprites used
